benchmark_split.method: Exact class-stratified 70/15/15 split using deterministic MD5 ordering of stable source row identifiers

label_repair: The raw CSV contains U+FFFD literally in the three Web Attack labels. Those labels were mapped deterministically to canonical ASCII class names during staging.
normalization_policy: No scaling was performed during preprocessing. All later scalers must be fit on training data only.
imbalance_policy: No class downsampling was performed during preprocessing.
